# Test Case 4: Tools Metadata Extraction

## Input
- Function: `segmentIntoTemplateTasks` in autonomous-trailblazing.ts
- Check for tools extraction from execution traces

## Expected Output
- `hasToolsProperty: true` - Task generation includes tools property
- `hasToolsPlanned: true` - Tools extracted from executedTask.task.toolsPlanned
- `hasRequiredOptionalDisabled: true` - Tools structure has required/optional/disabled arrays

## Vessel Architecture Implementation
This is the CRITICAL piece of the vessel-tools architecture:
- Tools are LEARNED from execution traces (not pre-planned)
- toolsPlanned (what agent planned to use) → TaskTools schema
- Stored in templates for future vessel distribution decisions
- Enables routing tasks to vessels with matching tool sets

## Data Flow
```
Agent generates task with toolsPlanned
  ↓
Task executes, toolCalls recorded
  ↓
segmentIntoTemplateTasks extracts toolsPlanned
  ↓
tools: { required: toolsPlanned, optional: [], disabled: [] }
  ↓
Template stored with tools metadata
  ↓
[FUTURE] Vessels check availability and accept tasks
```
